title: Daylight sea and sky
section: Second round: Acts III and IV
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite for Widow's Bay.
Open sea under a pale rose daylight sky with a few soft clouds and distant gulls; the horizon level at 60% of the height (860 px), a calm grey-teal sea with white lines of surf below it; no foreground rocks (the shore-rocks ground row stands in front). Match shore-rocks. Requested final aspect ratio 2560:1440. Opaque full-bleed scene; paint right to every boundary.
Input image is a style/palette reference; follow the written subject and geometry rather than reproducing unwanted elements.
No text or watermark.
